title: Israeli military begins a new thrust in Gaza, witnesses say
summary_or_snippet: Reuters reports that Israeli tanks advanced along the Salahudeen road west of the Yellow Line in central Gaza. Residents said nearby families fled amid gunfire and shelling. Reuters separately reports casualty claims and an Israeli military response; this edition does not combine those figures.

title: Winter Hits Gaza Hard as Food and Shelter Aid Runs Short, IOM and WFP Warn
summary_or_snippet: In a November 17 joint statement, IOM and WFP warn that funding shortfalls and access restrictions threaten winter humanitarian operations in Gaza. Shelters are being damaged and food assistance is being reduced. Funding figures cover Palestine beyond Gaza and are not presented as Gaza-only totals.
region_scope: Gaza Strip; funding scope includes Palestine
